meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Each quarter's figures come from the companies that reported in that quarter; growth rates compare the same companies a year apart and are final as printed.
meta.product: SDMX dataset PRF_LNGNFC_PUC_QTR_RN (Performance of Listed Non-Government Non-Financial Companies Quarterly - Paid-up-Capital)
meta.coverage: Listed private non-financial companies, growth on a year earlier by size of paid-up capital, quarterly
meta.note: Growth on the same period a year earlier, per cent, for the same companies in both periods. Shares (where given) are the cut's share of all companies' sales or paid-up capital.
